# Third-party code in avr-lcd-lcd-i2c.ino.hex

The firmware image is the sketch next to it linked with the libraries below,
with arduino-cli (see the sketch header). They are redistributed here in binary form
under their own licences.

| Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| LCD_I2C | 2.4.0 | GPL 3.0 |
| Arduino AVR core and Wire | as installed by the compile service | LGPL 2.1 or later |

## LCD_I2C

    LCD_I2C is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0, which is
    compatible with the AGPL-3.0 of this repository. Its source is at
    https://github.com/blackhack/LCD_I2C/tree/2.4.0.
